$comment: Authoritative attestation reference for the production publicai-gateway CVM. Fetched at runtime by the /proof page. composeHash was read back from the CVM's RTMR3 event log on 2026-09-09 and cross-checked against the Phala control-plane API; both report fb8fa9bb. Image digests are the linux/amd64 children of the cosign-signed proof-v37 index for sub2api (INDEX b3cfd4b3) built by publish-tee-images run 34331390426 from commit 8cd4fad1f; the attestor image is deliberately left at its proof-v20 pin because deploy/attestor carries no change since that release, and repinning it would widen the attested surface for nothing. VERIFICATION SCOPE, stated plainly: composeHash, the image digests and the build commit were each read back from a live source, and composeHash was cross-checked against two independent ones (RTMR3 event log and control plane). The cosign keyless signature was NOT verified locally for this release - the workflow performs the signing and its run succeeded, and anyone can verify certificate identity https://github.com/FiiLabs/sub2api/.github/workflows/publish-tee-images.yml@refs/heads/feat/two-sided-market plus the embedded githubWorkflowSha against the sourceCommit below, but this file does not claim it was done. This release adds three operator-facing features and touches no schema: (1) a dynamic supply/demand balance gate that can reject new supplier onboarding when supply is abundant relative to demand, or new consumer signups when supply is scarce - measured by headcount ratio (active schedulable supply accounts vs active users), fail-open on any read error, inactive below a configurable active-user sample floor, and OFF by default; (2) a public homepage stats surface and a standalone /stats dashboard page (KPIs with count-up and sparklines, a synthesized growth line, a real supply-by-platform donut, product-fact highlights, and a trust band linking to /proof) fed by GET /api/v1/stats/public - real aggregates (shared accounts, active users, requests, tokens, contributor earnings) plus operator-configured baseline offsets, also OFF by default; (3) homepage copy aligning consumer GPT-6 availability with the docs and replacing the model-live hero tile with an auto-failover tile. All three ship default-off / zero-offset, so production behavior is unchanged until an operator enables them: the Claude consumer serving path, the scheduler, and existing supplier onboarding are untouched, and the balance gate and stats display do nothing until switched on in admin. There is NO schema migration in this release - the gate and stats settings are stored as single JSON settings keys, and the two new read paths (a per-platform active-supply count and a SUM(history_credit)) are read-only queries. Verified before rollout: full backend build and vet, the entire backend unit suite (51 packages) including new balance-gate and homepage-stats unit tests, frontend type-check, production build, and the full vitest suite (2068 passing) including i18n parity and a new StatsView spec. A full postgres backup was taken and verified immediately beforehand - downloaded from S3, gzip-tested, 110 COPY sections - kept as a rollback point even though no schema changed. Earlier in this line: proof-v36 (OpenAI/ChatGPT contributor sharing side of the two-sided market, migration 239), proof-v35 (large upstream sync to 0.2.1 plus GPT-6 Astra), proof-v34 (fingerprint version floor), proof-v33 (impersonated client version bump), proof-v32 (consumer/contributor experience split), proof-v31 (a data migration), v29, v28, v27, v26 (earlier upstream sync, Claude Fable 5.1), v24..v15. osImageHash, appId and instanceId are unchanged; the deploy passed --no-dev-os explicitly, because phala deploy silently switches to a dev OS image when it detects a local SSH key and a dev OS would void the attestation, and the control plane confirms is_dev false after the rollout. This rollout completed in 90 seconds with no incident.
